summary.tldr: Updates many federal rules by changing notices, approvals, permits and reporting across business, agriculture, wildlife, immigration and transport laws.
what_it_does: Replaces some newspaper and Gazette publication rules with other notice methods, and lets some bankrupt people get a discharge certificate when certain oppositions are withdrawn.
Lets ministers or regulators approve temporary use of some unapproved devices, set extra conditions on approvals and permits, and use interim orders in several food, animal health and transport laws.
Renames corporate annual returns as annual update statements for federal corporations, co-operatives and not-for-profit corporations.

Updates agricultural marketing, feed, fertiliser, seed and animal health rules, including rules for releasing novel supplements, seeds and veterinary biologics, and lets the CFIA use electronic administration and enforcement.
Changes wildlife trade and species-at-risk rules, including the removal of some Schedule 3 species after COSEWIC assessment and new timelines for recovery and management plans.

Modernizes Canada Lands Surveyors complaints and discipline processes, creates an offence for breaking fisheries licence conditions, and allows new information-sharing rules for immigration and customs.
summary.background: The bill amends many Acts as part of the Regulatory Modernization Initiative. The drafters say it is meant to remove barriers to innovation and economic growth.
